title: Hanji paper
summary: Dip the mould in a vat of mulberry fibre, slosh it even, couch the sheet and pound it on a stone with a wooden mallet until it is smooth and tough.
howToPlay: Press Dip, then drag on the mould to tilt it.
Run the pulp to the thin, pale places before the water drains.
Drag the mould onto the stack and press Couch.
Pound each zone of the sheet as it lights, then press Check.
rules: The pulp runs towards the side you tilt to.
The water drains through the screen in nine seconds and the fibre stays where it lay: a sheet thick in one place and thin in another scores less.
The form of the sheet counts for 60 points, the couching for 20 and the finish for 20.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn makes a whole sheet for you.
heritageNote: Hanji is the traditional Korean paper made from the inner bark of the paper mulberry. Sheets are formed by rocking a mould in a vat and are later pounded with a wooden mallet to make them dense and smooth, strong enough for windows and doors.
